taxonomy.definition: The respondent argues the causal chain from a purchase to a grid emissions change cannot be attributed with defensible confidence.
taxonomy.label: Attribution uncertainty

taxonomy.definition: The respondent objects that the method cannot be implemented or verified at reasonable cost.
taxonomy.label: Complexity and audit burden

taxonomy.definition: The respondent argues inventory accounting alone misses system-level consequences and welcomes the consequential frame.
taxonomy.label: A system view is needed

taxonomy.definition: The respondent asks for tests calibrated to grid or regulatory context rather than one global rule.
taxonomy.label: Region-specific tests

taxonomy.definition: The respondent raises whether the required dispatch, capacity or contract data exists in their market.
taxonomy.label: Data availability
